name: A.P.C All-purpose Cleaner

features.text: Cleans grease, grime and soil from exterior and interior surfaces.
Reduces the number of products needed in a shop.

description: A general purpose cleaner designed to clean a wide variety of vehicle surfaces. This concentrated formula cleans grease, grime and soil from exterior and interior surfaces. A single product that does it all and reduces the numbers of products needed in a shop.
application: Application: Always test diluted product for spotting or damage on an inconspicuous area before using on an entire surface. Dilution: Always dilute with at least 12 parts water to 1 part product. 1) Spray or wipe diluted product on surface to be cleaned. 2) Scrub surface with a brush or towel. Do not allow product to dry on the surface. 3) For exterior areas, pressure rinse surface thoroughly. For interior hard surfaces, dry area completely with a clean towel. For carpet and upholstery, towel dry and vacuum area.
